intro: Thelgen Rock is an extensive cavern system cut into the southern mountain wall of the Wetlands. Infested with venomous spiders, it is notorious for harboring rare veins of volatile Incendicite Ore.

p: Nestled against the southern mountains separating the Wetlands from Loch Modan, Thelgen Rock is a deep subterranean cave network overrun by aggressive arachnids. The passages are thick with webs and crawling with poisonous spiders that make entering the caverns extremely hazardous for travelers. Despite the infestation, miners and adventurers brave its depths for the valuable deposits of Incendicite Ore found embedded in the rocky tunnels.
